claim_steps: Choose the On-Demand plan (Start free) at platform.inworld.ai/billing.
Use the included allowance for up to 70 minutes TTS or 400 minutes STT; LLM Router usage is billed separately at provider cost.

social_proof.text: On-Demand is great for testing and comes with up to 70 minutes of TTS or 400 minutes of STT for free.
social_proof.title: Pricing | Inworld AI

social_proof.text: 100+ LLM models via Router ... LLMs billed separately at provider cost.
social_proof.title: Inworld pricing — Router access is separately billed

summary: Inworld AI's On-Demand plan includes up to 70 minutes of TTS (or 400 minutes of STT) for free, plus voice cloning and Realtime API access. It advertises access to 100+ LLM models via Router, but Router LLM usage is billed separately at provider cost, not included as free inference.
